name: folderframe
description: FolderFrame is a folder-based photo and video gallery with album browsing and slideshows, served by Caddy. Select a dedicated media folder; it is mounted read-only. Configuration is stored separately in appdata. Anyone who can reach the WebUI can download its media. No authentication or TLS is configured. Use on a trusted LAN, or add access controls before public exposure. Do not select an entire share, source repository, private files, or a folder containing symlinks.

paths.name: Media Folder
paths.description: Select an existing dedicated gallery folder. Read-only does not prevent downloads. Do not select a whole share or repository.

paths.name: Appdata Configuration
paths.description: Persistent FolderFrame configuration. The default JSON file is created automatically on first start.

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Choose an unused host port for the gallery.

variables.name: Source Label
variables.description: Optional label for the mounted media source. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Starting View
variables.description: Optional starting view: folders or all. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Default Sort
variables.description: Optional default sort: filename, newest, or oldest. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Slideshow Interval
variables.description: Optional photo duration in seconds: 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 300, 900, or 3600. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Image Display Mode
variables.description: Optional image sizing: fit or original. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Start Automatically
variables.description: Optional slideshow startup: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Shuffle by Default
variables.description: Optional shuffle default: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Gallery Refresh Interval
variables.description: Optional gallery rescan interval from 1 to 86400 seconds. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Embed Refresh Interval
variables.description: Optional embed rescan interval from 1 to 86400 seconds. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Remember Browser Preferences
variables.description: Optional preference persistence: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.
